normal: paragraph: The email APIs SendMock answers like the real provider. Change a built-in, remove the ones you do not use, or add your own.
Add a provider dialog: paragraph: Answer a provider SendMock does not ship, from blank or from the closest email provider; you set its requests and responses next.
paragraph: Its /providers/<key>/ path and the name stored on messages; fixed once added.
Provider editor, General tab: paragraph: Built-in Key sendgrid , # messages in the last # hours.
paragraph: Its /providers/<key>/ path and the name stored on messages; fixed once added.
paragraph: The provider's API host. On the provider port it tells apart providers that share a path.
paragraph: The colour of its badge on messages.
paragraph: What your app is configured with. Templates read them as credentials.<name> ; secrets stay masked, in the preview too.
paragraph: Off: any credentials pass. On: a request without a secret credential gets the provider's unauthorized answer.
Provider editor, Requests tab: paragraph: The paths as the provider's API has them; use {name} for a part that changes, like /v#/{domain}/messages .
paragraph: A JSON path ( personalizations[*].to[*].email ), a form field ( To ) or h:* for every field with a prefix. Anything unmapped is kept as metadata.
Provider editor, Responses tab: paragraph: Templates read request , message , error and credentials ; the Preview tab lists every value with an example.
paragraph: The provider's id for each message, e.g. SM{{ random_hex(#) }}.
Provider editor, Callbacks tab: paragraph: The webhook template its status callbacks and inbound messages are sent with; edit it in Webhooks > Templates.
paragraph: The provider's name for each SendMock status, as its callbacks and fetch answers show it.
Provider editor, Preview tab: paragraph: A send built from the field mapping. Edit it to try another request.
Provider editor, Try it tab: button: Copy sdk base url (provider port)
button: Copy base url on the main port
paragraph: The provider port answers once it is on ( --provider-addr ). The preview shows what this request gets back: #. Settings > Connection has the snippets for each language.
